data.title: 卡莲 · 教会软榻的深情仰卧索吻
data.description: 幽静的教会祷告室内，卡莲侧倚在华丽的深蓝天鹅绒长榻上。纯白的礼装纽扣解开，露出白皙锁骨与纤细颈项。鲜红的圣骸布缎带静静垂在身侧靠垫上作为点缀，银色短发散落，琥珀色的双眸在温暖的壁灯与烛火中倒映着近在咫尺的身影。
data.location: 教会幽静祷告室深处天鹅绒长榻中央
data.action: 侧卧在圣堂深蓝天鹅绒软榻上，解开衣领的白礼服微敞，红色圣骸布如缎带般垂落在沙发靠垫旁，琥珀眼眸微润含羞凝望
data.lighting: 昏暗柔和的壁灯与烛火勾勒娇躯线条
data.camera: cowboy shot, lying on side on velvet couch, warm church candlelight
data.promptProse: Caren Hortensia lying on her side on a navy blue velvet couch, white ceremonial dress unbuttoned at collar, bare shoulders and collarbone, red decorative shroud ribbons draped across the couch cushions, short silver hair, amber eyes, gentle blush, looking at viewer, church prayer room, dim wall lamps, warm candlelight.
data.animaCaption: She lies on her side on the velvet couch with red ribbons draped beside her.
